IN-UK-DEHRADUN-01.name: Dehradun Foothills Monitoring Corridor
IN-UK-DEHRADUN-01.verification_source: NHAI Highway Corridor Survey & Survey of India Toposheet
IN-UK-DEHRADUN-01.imagery_source: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (Sentinel-2 L2A Dynamically Retrieved)
IN-UK-DEHRADUN-01.provisional_disclaimer: PROVISIONAL / NOT SCIENTIFICALLY CALIBRATED. Reflects observed optical canopy/soil surface disturbance only; NOT predictive hazard or confirmed landslide severity.
IN-UK-DEHRADUN-01.status_explanation: LOW_OBSERVED_RISK: Bi-temporal spectral comparison between 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-25 shows no significant mass-wasting signature across the monitored corridor (mean ΔNDVI: +0.002). High single-image CNN score (1.0000) was correctly rejected as out-of-distribution saturation.

detailed_evaluation.status_explanation: LOW_OBSERVED_RISK: Bi-temporal spectral comparison between 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-25 shows no significant mass-wasting signature across the monitored corridor (mean ΔNDVI: +0.002). High single-image CNN score (1.0000) was correctly rejected as out-of-distribution saturation.
detailed_evaluation.assessment_type_explanation: This assessment evaluates surface disturbance between paired satellite observations. It is a post-event disturbance screening tool, NOT a pre-event predictive early warning system, and does NOT forecast the exact timing of future slope failures.

data_provenance.imagery_source: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (Sentinel-2 L2A Dynamically Retrieved)

candidate_alert.imagery_source: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (Sentinel-2 L2A Dynamically Retrieved)

cnn_inference_diagnostics.scientific_warning: Sigmoid score represents uncalibrated mathematical activation, NOT posterior probability. Single-image CNN v2 has 0% validated specificity on Indian healthy vegetation.

bi_temporal_change_detection.summary_description: No significant mass-wasting spectral signature observed between 2026-10-22T05:32:41.024000Z and 2026-10-25T05:29:09.024000Z. Candidate pixels (0) below threshold (50).
caveats: Optical change detection reflects land surface alteration but cannot distinguish landslides from agricultural clearing, intentional logging, or seasonal phenology without terrain context.
Cloud shadows or subtle atmospheric differences between passes can induce minor localized NDVI fluctuations.

terrain_topography_context.note: Digital Elevation Model (DEM) data was not provided for this pass. Optical change detection continues without topographic constraint.

limitations_and_missing_evidence: Optical Sentinel-2 imagery cannot detect terrain beneath dense cloud cover (frequent during monsoon season).
Single-image optical classification cannot differentiate historical bare rock cliffs from fresh landslides without bi-temporal change.
Bi-temporal optical change detection can capture non-landslide surface disturbances (agricultural harvesting, logging, fires).
This microservice is an experimental geospatial prototype and must NOT be used as an autonomous life-safety early warning system.
